title: Aoyagi Toya — Tracing Brilliant Memories〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Hotel - Cafe Entrance
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey.
You looking at something on your phone?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good morning, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just received a message from my brother.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Your brother? The one who introduced us to Mr. Lloyd?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, not Shuji.
My oldest brother, Natsuomi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi's Message
rows.Line: <Shuji told me that you're over in the US.>

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi's Message
rows.Line: <I was hoping that we could talk, but I unfortunately haven't been able to find the time. I want to tell you at least this.>

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi's Message
rows.Line: <Toya. Few have the privilege of leading lives free of regret. You could probably say that no such people exist.>

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi's Message
rows.Line: <However, at the very least, I'm hoping that you're able to pursue your dream with your friends without any regrets.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Really...?
Your oldest brother gave you his blessing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's great.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You told me you guys weren't really close because he's so much older than you, so I pictured someone like your dad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But he seems sympathetic about how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In retrospect, we likely became distant because I was subconsciously trying to get away from him.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Just as I wanted to avoid my dad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I know that was a tough time for you, but you're doing pretty well for yourself now. That includes how things are between you, your dad and your brothers.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I mean, my family's sort of the same.
But I don't think you've actually met my dad yet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't know much about your dad...
But your sister seems very caring.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Caring? Her?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, moving on...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're doing really well.
Especially when it comes to your dad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I suppose I am.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, don't suppose. You are.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because you were able to work up the courage to actually face him, you know how he really feels now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that's true...
I am glad that I know now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He was simply trying to do what he could to ensure my happiness.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, when we first teamed up, I remember becoming really irritated every time your dad came up.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because I couldn't figure out why he wasn't letting his son do what he wanted.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I remember...
You used to get very angry each time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's because you refused to get mad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just so you know, the look of hopelessness on your face also bugged me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I honestly thought that you should try to get your way by using whatever means necessary, even if you had to punch him in the face.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. My hand hurts just thinking about that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Obviously, you'd never actually hit your dad or anything...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But in another world, I might've ended up barging into your house to give him a piece of my mind.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that's certainly a possibility.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However, if that did happen, then that would've likely been it for us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After all, my dad did keep saying that you were a bad influence on me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, I was the problem?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course, I tried to convince him otherwise, but he refused to budge.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Back then, the way he belittled Akito irritated me so much that I tried arguing back...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But now, we can laugh about it.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Because I was able to face him, tell him how I feel and blaze my own trail.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Which is nice.)
